_readme: Site-wide settings for the static portal (GitHub Pages). Paste keys between the quotes, save and push (or edit on GitHub). geminiApiKey switches on the AI assistant; openWeatherApiKey switches on live OpenWeather rain/cloud map layers and current conditions. WARNING: this file is public - restrict each key to https://jmsmuigai.github.io/* in the provider's console. Leave empty to keep the feature off.
